name: 2D Gaussian Splatting
aliases: 2D Gaussian Splatting for Geometrically Accurate Radiance Fields
definition: A surface reconstruction technique that replaces 3D Gaussians with 2D disks to improve spatial localization and recover high-resolution normal maps.
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting is a surface reconstruction technique using oriented 2D planar disks to improve spatial localization and recover high-resolution normal maps, solving the conflict between volumetric radiance representation and thin surfaces.
